While I was writing this I forwarded the question to Fable medium and it had the same conclusion (good clanker 😇) :
> So the honest description of the second loop is: the ticks are what matter (destroy hooks fire asynchronously after collection), and the gc() calls are belt-and-braces for intermediate promises the WeakRef doesn't track, in case they need another pass once their retainers died in an earlier cycle. On current Node/V8 that extra collection changes nothing in either direction, but it costs microseconds and guards against GC-behavior drift across Node versions, so I'd leave it.
